title: An Expert in Traffic Jams Has a Scary Idea: What if the Cars Turn on Us?
summary: Sam Schwartz, a former New York City traffic commissioner, thinks autonomous vehicles are the future. But his book, “Autokill,” imagines a world where they go very wrong.
